newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas to buy out CEP unit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Havas to buy out CEP unit-paper.

text.p: Media group Havas is proposing to buy out minority shareholders in its 73 percent-controlled CEP Communications subsidiary, the French newspaper Les Echos reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed sources.
No one at Havas was immediately available to comment.
Rumours of a buyout boosted Havas shares on Tuesday, while trading in shares in CEP was suspended at the company's request.

Les Echos said such an operation would be in line with Havas' strategy to increase its control of subsidiaries. It said CEP's last quoted price of 400 francs was viewed by the market as a "modest valuation" of the firm.
